# chronosphere_clickhouse_cloud_external_connection (Resource)

ClickHouse Cloud API key that a `chronosphere_cloud_integration` with `provider_type = "clickhouse_cloud"` references through `external_connection_slug` to collect ClickHouse Cloud metrics.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "clickhouse_cloud_key_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "clickhouse_cloud_key_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "chronosphere_clickhouse_cloud_external_connection" "clickhouse_cloud" {
  name       = "ClickHouse Cloud"
  key_id     = var.clickhouse_cloud_key_id
  key_secret = var.clickhouse_cloud_key_secret
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key_id` (String) ID of a ClickHouse Cloud API key, sent as the HTTP Basic username. At most 256 bytes, with no colon, whitespace or control characters.
- `key_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret of the same ClickHouse Cloud API key, sent as the HTTP Basic password, with no whitespace or control characters. The API never returns the secret, so a secret changed outside Terraform is not detected, and an imported connection plans one update to set it.
- `name` (String) Display name of the external connection.

### Optional

- `slug` (String) Stable identifier for the connection. Generated from `name` if omitted. Immutable after creation, so changing it replaces the connection. If a `chronosphere_cloud_integration` uses the connection, the replacement needs `create_before_destroy` and a new `name` in the same apply, because a connection in use cannot be deleted and names are unique.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
